unwiredAsKernels.note: 42 import-free f64 scalar kernels (add/sub/mul/div/mod/neg/sqrt/pow/square/cube/cbrt/nthRoot/exp/expm1/log/log1p/log10/log2/sin/cos/tan/asin/acos/atan/atan2/sinh/cosh/tanh/asinh/acosh/atanh/abs/floor/ceil/round/trunc/sign/min/max/clamp/isNaN/isFinite) are exported from the AS entry (assembly/src/index.ts:34+) and compiled into mathts-as.wasm, but no JS bridge calls any of them — the public scalar paths are plain JS.
